command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e (spawn#707).
# spawn's task shell drops the image PATH; R needs a writable TMPDIR and HOME.
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_VERBOSE=2
cd /tmp
: > signac.log; : > qc.tsv
printf '0813248a84f875de50735866461cde046dde1cd994d520a03bfefd414f19c32f  fragments.tsv.gz\n0062587c718db8596887ba8aaba056561daf62345fd15aef182a7d67e036b07e  fragments.tsv.gz.tbi\n5267f3afe6426e9f010957d46a50ebb97ab629167e2d1d76576afbf7b2be9f93  peaks.bed\na2f114226e4c2b1de3f2da942bbb82bf189ae7d35fe6dbc28de7811efd8ae883  ref/barcodes.tsv\nd4fd832aafc71a364d1cb7e89f8449ce0a245a349407782e335cf2ba8687a525  ref/cells.txt\nf64365ca0b2a1eb1558df2b8040eaaeed38a1d8e1886c1e95365449aa349b050  ref/cols_1.tsv\need6781bb63ac147b46975f811b0ef4e53751e9709df7435989d785a9c5b9aa8  ref/cols_2.tsv\nd44b854c44b995a74e1a0682717103066b6b8d93885cf9d7ef5a33ccdd39e717  ref/data.sha256\n216e21dfea6318d019a02e3fb76a15c1d51a537bf114fa9ff287dd96785b345f  ref/genes.tsv\na992da8ce52316977846da51eb000e5a92651635f6665c01423b265dc1b649ca  ref/nfirst.tsv\n512a86c30f77ecaa162e64a25f52d4a9e88bcf56d9c8aee3315e5611d1dae389  ref/peakfrag.tsv\n80b40c6984ff6a904608bf1385e32edc5b59146b10c01d763f5554ab4b5c9f8e  ref/rows_1.tsv\n45da14adcb8215d614b9c541241f4d0013ac545ea22a95b60adcb14486f06101  ref/rows_2.tsv\nc96f4635247f428e03d6afb9f95c8b622adb90fccee29b7717e92f17e17cd8cf  ref/stats.tsv\n3796b6fd8a8d48c263dff051258112f77d8c7c8b17da86cf76484d7293c2ecc4  ref/windows.bed\n9b9e3ca083e0cd88c5c5f3d7ac21ab8e7d468aee43a34fe4d83091d1a9e8310f  signac-real.R\n' > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 > pins.log 2>&1 || { cat pins.log; echo "FAIL: a staged file does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
echo "all $(wc -l < pins.sha256) staged files match their pins"
{ uname -m; nproc; grep -m1 -E 'model name|CPU part' /proc/cpuinfo; grep -c ^processor /proc/cpuinfo;
  echo "threads per core (cpu0 siblings): $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/topology/thread_siblings_list)"; } > cpu.txt 2>&1; cat cpu.txt
T0=$(date +%s)
Rscript signac-real.R > signac.log 2>&1; RC=$?
T1=$(date +%s)
cat signac.log
echo "signac-real.R rc $RC in $((T1-T0)) s"
for f in /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.max_usage_in_bytes; do [ -r "$f" ] && echo "cgroup_peak $(cat $f) ($f)"; done
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: a Signac check failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q '^SIGNAC OK' signac.log || { echo "FAIL: signac-real.R did not reach completion"; exit 1; }
test -s qc.tsv && test -s lsi_u.tsv.gz || { echo "FAIL: outputs are empty"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
